nodes.name: Metastable IrOx colloid preparation
nodes.procedure: 28.4 mg of Na3IrCl6 · x H2O was mixed with 30 ml of 0.1 M NaOH (2 mM nominal iridium concentration). The pale-yellow solution was transferred to a water-jacketed glass container and heated to 85 °C (solution temperature 75 °C) for 20 min with 300 r.p.m. stirring. Color changed from pale-yellow to transparent grey, light violet, then blue. The colloidal solution was cooled in ice bath, acidified to pH ~1.5 with 70% HClO4 (dark purple), then basified to pH ~12.5 with 10.1 M NaOH (violet). Solution stored up to 3 months at 4 °C.
nodes.source_text: First, a metastable IrO colloid suspension was obtained from an alkaline hydrolysis of Ir3+. Then, 28.4 mg of Na3IrCl6 · x H2O was mixed with 30 ml of 0.1 M NaOH (2 mM of nominal iridium)... The solution was stored for up to 3 months at 4 °C.

nodes.name: IrOx/GC electrodeposition and dehydration
nodes.procedure: GC disk mechanically polished (6, 1, 0.05 μm diamond paste sequentially), rinsed, sonicated 1 min in DI water. RRDE vertically immersed in 4 ml IrOx colloid (pH ~1.55 by 70% HClO4 addition). Electrodeposited by CA at 1.25±0.01 VAg/AgCl (~300±30 s) at 600 r.p.m. rotation (no gas purging). Formed reflective bluish-violet film. Washed with DI water, heated 75 °C oven 6 h (0.45 °C/min ramp) to dehydrate (color changed to reflective black).
nodes.source_text: For electrodeposition, the RRDE was vertically immersed into the IrOx colloidal solution... CA at 1.25±0.01 VAg/AgCl for ∼300±30 s... The electrodeposited RRDE was washed with deionized water, and then heated in a 75 °C oven for 6 h.

nodes.name: IrOx/FTO electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: 94.78 mg of Na3IrCl6 · x H2O and 90.03 mg of oxalic acid were dissolved in 50 ml of deionized water (2 mM nominal iridium), and 529.95 mg of Na2CO3 was added to adjust the pH to 10. The solution was kept in the incubator at 35 °C for 4 days and then stored in a refrigerator at 4 °C. The electrodeposition set-up was same as the single-compartment configuration of IrOx/GC, while chronopotentiometry was conducted at 35 μA for 1,000 s, resulting in the IrOx/FTO electrode.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM images show partially cracked surface covered by IrOx nanoparticles 0.2-1 μm in diameter.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The SEM images of the as-electrodeposited IrOx/GC show a partially cracked surface covered by IrO_x nanoparticles, 0.2-1 μm in diameter (Supplementary Fig. 3).

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS detected no alkali metal cations remaining on the IrOx/GC surface after measurements.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Energy-dispersive X-ray analysis (EDX) detected that no alkali metal cations were left on the IrO_x/GC surface after measurements (Supplementary Fig. 6).

nodes.characterization_summary: CLSM shows ~1 μm surface roughening after CER/OER measurements which is less than 10% of the diffusion layer thickness.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the surface roughening analysed by scanning electron microscopy (SEM; Supplementary Fig. 3) and confocal laser scanning microscopy (Supplementary Fig. 4) was ~1 μm. This is less than 10% of the diffusion layer thickness at 3,600 r.p.m.
